defaultProvider.description: The provider gobble uses, with its first model; its credential variable must be set. Empty takes the first provider whose credential variable is set.

defaultModel.description: The model a new session starts with, of defaultProvider's, its id exactly. Empty takes the provider's first listed model; without defaultProvider it is ignored.

cacheRetention.description: How long the model service keeps a session's prompt cached: none, short (five minutes on Anthropic's models) or long (an hour).

defaultThinkingLevel.description: The thinking level a new session starts with.

steeringMode.description: How steering messages queued while a turn runs reach the model: one before each model call, or all at once.

followUpMode.description: How follow-up messages queued while a turn runs reach the model: one at a time, or all at once.

sessionDir.description: The directory session files are kept in, flat, as --session-dir keeps them. Empty keeps them in gobble's data directory, by working directory.

keepRecentTokens.description: The recent conversation, in tokens, that /compact keeps word for word.

enabled.description: Whether a failed model call is retried: the provider's retries, the wait for the network, and an empty reply's two more runs.

maxRetries.description: How many times the provider retries a failed call.

baseDelayMs.description: The provider's first wait before a retry, in milliseconds; each later wait doubles.

maxDelayMs.description: The longest wait before a retry, in milliseconds; a service asking for longer is not retried.

offlineWaitMs.description: How long, in milliseconds, a turn waits for the network to come back; 0 does not wait.

shellPath.description: The bash the bash tool runs. Empty finds one: Git's bash on Windows, bash on PATH elsewhere.

shellCommandPrefix.description: A line run before every bash command, such as "set -euo pipefail".

useClientTerminal.description: Whether bash runs in the ACP client's terminal when the client offers one.

maxTimeoutMs.description: The longest timeout, in milliseconds, a bash command may ask for.

startupWaitMs.description: How long, in milliseconds, the first prompt waits for MCP servers to connect.

stopGraceMs.description: How long, in milliseconds, a stdio MCP server has to exit once its input closes.

stopTimeoutMs.description: How long, in milliseconds, after the grace before a stdio MCP server is killed.

externalEditor.description: The editor /edit and gobble config edit open. GOBBLE_EDITOR wins over it; it wins over VISUAL and EDITOR.

title: gobble settings.yaml
description: gobble's settings. Every key is optional; a key left out takes its default.
